mentions.name: Agentic action cam video editor
mentions.description: A personal agentic tool for action cam video editing that automatically finds scenes in hours-long helmet cam footage (moto, ski, bike) and edits them down into a reel or video with basic cuts and transitions, suited to amateur use.
mentions.audience: Takes a very long time to find scenes in hours of rolling helmet cam footage and edit them down into a reel or video.
mentions.source_excerpt: A personal agentic tool for action cam video editing. When I moto / ski / bike, I leave my helmet cam rolling the entire time.

evidence.value: A personal agentic tool for action cam video editing. When I moto / ski / bike, I leave my helmet cam rolling the entire time.
